sample_method: scrambled Sobol on two independent BZ momenta
included: full quantum SCHA propagator including periodic dipolar kernel
local sextic contractions dressing the quartic vertex
local octic contractions dressing the quartic vertex
excluded: quartic-sextic, sextic-sextic, sextic-octic and octic-octic skeletons
post-SCHA refit of the lattice-matching pressure
sign_convention: Gamma^(2)=A_SCHA+Sigma_post; negative delta_A1 softens the mode
numerical_error_note: The per-row iid_se_diagnostic is the dispersion of integrand samples divided by sqrt(N); it is not a rigorous randomized-QMC confidence interval. Independent scrambled-Sobol convergence must be used for a production uncertainty.
